criterion: Preserve cooking distinctions when normal substitution materially changes a recipe. Add explicit definitions, reuse verified existing identities and retain uncertainty. All existing entries/source fields and retired identities remain unchanged except approved alias suffixes. No recipe rewriting, automatic recognition, nutrition equivalence or runtime changes.

research.note: All 150 second-sample candidate phrases plus explicitly reviewed existing-name discoveries. Qualified alternatives do not resolve ambiguous bare names. All generated audit data remains external.

additions.label: cavatappi

additions.label: ditalini

additions.label: ziti

additions.label: penne rigate

additions.label: whole-wheat rigatoni

additions.label: cheese tortellini

additions.label: dried rice noodles

additions.label: cooked egg noodles

additions.label: instant white rice

additions.label: whole-wheat tortillas

additions.label: monosodium glutamate

additions.label: fresh mozzarella

additions.label: hoop cheese
additions.description: Traditional American hoop-pressed cow-milk cheese sold as hoop cheese. Exact maturity, fat content and wax color are unspecified; not automatically a specific Cheddar formulation.

additions.label: nonfat Greek yogurt
additions.description: Strained Greek-style yogurt made as a nonfat formulation; flavoring is unspecified. Distinct from whole-milk/low-fat Greek yogurt and from unstrained nonfat yogurt.

additions.label: nonfat plain Greek yogurt
additions.description: Unflavored nonfat strained Greek-style yogurt. Distinct from flavored nonfat Greek yogurt and plain nonfat unstrained yogurt.

additions.label: low-fat Greek yogurt
additions.description: Strained Greek-style yogurt in a low-fat formulation; exact fat percentage and flavoring are unspecified. Distinct from nonfat/full-fat Greek yogurt and ordinary unstrained low-fat yogurt.

additions.label: low-fat mozzarella

additions.label: reduced-fat cream cheese

additions.label: reduced-fat sharp Cheddar

additions.label: extra-sharp Cheddar

additions.label: 1% fat buttermilk

additions.label: low-fat vanilla yogurt

additions.label: reduced-fat firm tofu

additions.label: vegetable stock powder

additions.label: Irish whiskey

additions.label: medium-dry sherry

additions.label: golden beets

additions.label: ground annatto seed

additions.label: dried red chili peppers

additions.label: dried summer savory leaves

additions.label: dark corn syrup

additions.label: toffee-coated popcorn
